english_before: Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father!” He answered, “Here I am, my son.” Isaac said, “Here are the fire and the wood, but where is the animal for the burnt offering?”
english_after: Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father!” He answered, “Here I am, my son.” Isaac said, “Here are the fire and the wood, but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִצְחָק אֶל־אַבְרָהָם אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי בְנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הָאֵשׁ וְהָעֵצִים וְאַיֵּה הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה׃

english_before: Abraham said, “God will provide for Himself the animal for the burnt offering, my son.” The two went together.
english_after: Abraham said, “God will provide for Himself the sheep for the burnt offering, my son.” The two went together.
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהִים יִרְאֶה־לּוֹ הַשֶּׂה לְעֹלָה בְּנִי וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו׃

english_before: “And she quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels.’ So I drank, and she watered my camels.”
english_after: “She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll give your camels water too.’ So I drank, and she gave the camels water too.”
hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר וַתּוֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁתֵה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּיךָ אַשְׁקֶה וָאֵשְׁתְּ וְגַם הַגְּמַלִּים הִשְׁקָתָה׃

english_before: Now Rebekah heard Isaac speaking to Esau, his son; and Esau went out into the plain to hunt game and bring it.
english_after: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. Esau went out into the open country to hunt game and bring it back.
hebrew: וְרִבְקָה שֹׁמַעַת בְּדַבֵּר יִצְחָק אֶל־עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו הַשָּׂדֶה לָצוּד צַיִד לְהָבִיא׃

english_before: Therefore the Israelites do not eat the sinew at the hip socket to this day, because he touched Jacob’s hip socket at that sinew.
english_after: That is why, to this day, the Israelites do not eat the sciatic sinew at the hip socket: he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip at that sinew.
hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־גִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּף הַיָּרֵךְ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי נָגַע בְּכַף־יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּגִיד הַנָּשֶׁה׃

english_before: And Husham died, and Hadad, son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
english_after: And Husham died, and Hadad, son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
hebrew: וַיָּמָת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן־בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת־מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

english_before: So he returned to Judah and said, “I did not find her; and moreover, the men of the place said, ‘There is no prostitute here.’”
english_after: So he returned to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her. The men of the place even said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אֶל־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא־הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

english_before: And it came to pass after three months that it was reported to Judah, saying, “Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the prostitute, and behold, she is with child from prostitution.” Then Judah said, “Bring her out and let her be burned.”
english_after: About three months later Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has acted as a prostitute, and now she is pregnant through prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out and let her be burned.”
hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

english_before: “And they went into their bellies; yet it was completely imperceptible that they had gone into their bellies, for their appearance remained as ugly as at the beginning, then I awoke.”
english_after: “They went into their bellies, but there was no sign they had gone in. They looked as ugly as before. Then I woke up.”
hebrew: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל־קִרְבֶּנָה וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי־בָאוּ אֶל־קִרְבֶּנָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶן רַע כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה וָאִיקָץ׃

english_before: And the famine was upon the face of all the earth. Then Joseph opened all the granaries and sold to all the Egyptians; and the famine prevailed in the land of Egypt.
english_after: And the famine was upon the face of all the earth. Then Joseph opened all the granaries and sold to the Egyptians; and the famine prevailed in the land of Egypt.
hebrew: וְהָרָעָב הָיָה עַל כָּל־פְּנֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיִּפְתַּח יוֹסֵף אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּהֶם וַיִּשְׁבֹּר לְמִצְרַיִם וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

english_before: And Pharaoh asked Jacob, “How many are the years of the days of your life?”
english_after: Pharaoh asked Jacob, “How many are the days of the years of your life?”
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יַעֲקֹב כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

english_before: YHWH said to Moses, “I will bring one more plague upon Pharaoh and Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will drive you out completely.
english_after: YHWH said to Moses, “I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will drive you out of here altogether.
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה עוֹד נֶגַע אֶחָד אָבִיא עַל־פַּרְעֹה וְעַל־מִצְרַיִם אַחֲרֵי־כֵן יְשַׁלַּח אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה כְּשַׁלְּחוֹ כָּלָה גָּרֵשׁ יְגָרֵשׁ אֶתְכֶם מִזֶּה׃

english_before: These shall belong to Aaron and his sons by a perpetual statute from the sons of Israel. It is a contribution, taken from the sacrifices of their peace offerings as their contribution to YHWH.
english_after: These shall belong to Aaron and his sons from the Israelites by a perpetual statute. It is a contribution. The Israelites shall give it from their peace offerings as their contribution to YHWH.
hebrew: וְהָיָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו לְחָק־עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי תְרוּמָה הוּא וּתְרוּמָה יִהְיֶה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם תְּרוּמָתָם לַיהוָה׃

english_before: For the cloud of YHWH was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was over it by night, in the sight of the whole house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
english_after: For the cloud of YHWH was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of the whole house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
hebrew: כִּי עֲנַן יְהוָה עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כָל־בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־מַסְעֵיהֶם׃

english_before: After it has been washed, the priest shall examine the lesion. If it has not changed its appearance, though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it with fire; it is a corrosive condition on its bare side or its hairy side.
english_after: After the affected article has been washed, the priest shall examine it. If the lesion looks the same, even though it has not spread, the article is unclean. Burn it with fire. The damage has eaten into it, whether on the back or the front.
hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֶת־הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָפַךְ הַנֶּגַע אֶת־עֵינוֹ וְהַנֶּגַע לֹא־פָשָׂה טָמֵא הוּא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ פְּחֶתֶת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

english_before: Those of you who remain shall waste away in their guilt in their enemies’ lands; also in the guilt of their fathers they shall waste away with them.
english_after: Those of you who remain will waste away in your enemies’ lands because of their own guilt. They will also waste away with their fathers because of their fathers’ guilt.
hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם יִמַּקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְאַף בַּעֲוֺנֹת אֲבֹתָם אִתָּם יִמָּקּוּ׃

english_before: Moses took one out of every fifty, from the people and livestock, and gave them to the Levites who kept the charge of YHWH’s tabernacle, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
english_after: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty people and animals. He gave them to the Levites who kept charge of YHWH’s tabernacle, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָאָחֻז אֶחָד מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן־הָאָדָם וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

english_before: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt and that YHWH your God brought you out with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore YHWH your God commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.
english_after: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt and that YHWH your God brought you out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore YHWH your God commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.
hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי־עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֹּצִאֲךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מִשָּׁם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרֹעַ נְטוּיָה עַל־כֵּן צִוְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־יוֹם הַשַׁבָּת׃

english_before: houses full of good things you did not fill, hewn cisterns you did not hew, vineyards and olive groves you did not plant—and you eat and are satisfied,
english_after: houses you did not fill, full of every good thing, cisterns cut out that you did not cut, vineyards and olive groves you did not plant, and when you eat and are satisfied,
hebrew: וּבָתִּים מְלֵאִים כָּל־טוּב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מִלֵּאתָ וּבֹרֹת חֲצוּבִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָצַבְתָּ כְּרָמִים וְזֵיתִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָטָעְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ׃

english_before: Take your sacred things and your vowed offerings and go to the place YHWH will choose.
english_after: But take the sacred things you have and your vowed offerings, and go to the place YHWH will choose.
hebrew: רַק קָדָשֶׁיךָ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיוּ לְךָ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תִּשָּׂא וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר יְהוָה׃

english_before: Rejoice, nations, with His people, for He avenges His servants’ blood, repays His adversaries, and makes atonement for His land and people.
english_after: Sing in praise of His people, you nations, for He avenges the blood of His servants, repays His adversaries, and makes atonement for His land and people.
hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ כִּי דַם־עֲבָדָיו יִקּוֹם וְנָקָם יָשִׁיב לְצָרָיו וְכִפֶּר אַדְמָתוֹ עַמּוֹ׃

english_before: Then a remnant went down to the nobles; YHWH’s people went down for me among the warriors.
english_after: Then the survivors ruled over the mighty of the nations. YHWH gave me rule over the warriors.
hebrew: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃

english_before: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers; Shallum was the head.
english_after: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman; their brother Shallum was the head.
hebrew: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלּוּם וְעַקּוּב וְטַלְמֹן וַאֲחִימָן וַאֲחִיהֶם שַׁלּוּם הָרֹאשׁ׃

english_before: We are strangers before You and resident sojourners, like all our fathers. Our days upon the earth are like a shadow, and there is no abiding hope.
english_after: For we are strangers and sojourners before You, like all our fathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.
hebrew: כִּי־גֵרִים אֲנַחְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִים כְּכָל־אֲבֹתֵינוּ כַּצֵּל יָמֵינוּ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מִקְוֶה׃

english_after: [BHS 23:14] Jehoiada the priest brought out the commanders of hundreds appointed over the force and said to them, “Take her out between the ranks, and anyone following her shall be put to death with the sword.” For the priest had said, “Do not put her to death in YHWH's house.”
hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת פְּקוּדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הוֹצִיאוּהָ אֶל־מִבֵּית הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ יוּמַת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן לֹא תְמִיתוּהָ בֵּית יְהוָה׃

english_before: I directed them to Iddo, the head at the place Casiphia, and put words in their mouths to speak to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, to bring us ministers for the house of our God.
english_after: I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and told them what to say to Iddo and his brother among the Nethinim there, so they would bring us servants for the house of our God.
hebrew: ואוצאה [וָאֲצַוֶּה] אוֹתָם עַל־אִדּוֹ הָרֹאשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם וָאָשִׂימָה בְּפִיהֶם דְּבָרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל־אִדּוֹ אָחִיו הנתונים [הַנְּתִינִים] בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם לְהָבִיא־לָנוּ מְשָׁרְתִים לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english_before: | conventional 10:33 for the bread arranged before God, the regular grain offering and the regular burnt offering, the Sabbaths, new moons and appointed feasts, the holy offerings and the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and all the work of the house of our God.
english_after: | conventional 10:33 for the bread set out in rows, the regular grain and burnt offerings, the Sabbaths, new moons, and appointed feasts, the holy offerings and the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and all the work of the house of our God.
hebrew: לְלֶחֶם הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וּלְעוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד הַשַּׁבָּתוֹת הֶחֳדָשִׁים לַמּוֹעֲדִים וְלַקֳּדָשִׁים וְלַחַטָּאוֹת לְכַפֵּר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english_before: The hungry eat his harvest and take it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after their wealth.
english_after: The hungry eat his harvest and take it even from among thorns, and robbers pant after their wealth.
hebrew: אֲשֶׁר קְצִירוֹ רָעֵב יֹאכֵל וְאֶל־מִצִּנִּים יִקָּחֵהוּ וְשָׁאַף צַמִּים חֵילָם׃

english_before: I will make my sin known to You; I have not covered my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my rebellions against myself to YHWH,” and You bore away the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
english_after: I made my sin known to You and did not cover my guilt. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to YHWH.” And You lifted away the guilt of my sin. Selah.
hebrew: חַטָּאתִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ וַעֲוֺנִי לֹא־כִסִּיתִי אָמַרְתִּי אוֹדֶה עֲלֵי פְשָׁעַי לַיהוָה וְאַתָּה נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן חַטָּאתִי סֶלָה׃

english_before: If you see a thief, you run with him; your portion is with adulterers.
english_after: If you see a thief, you are pleased with him; your portion is with adulterers.
hebrew: אִם־רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶךָ׃

english_before: Let them be despised; let them walk as through water. He will aim His arrows, so that they are cut down.
english_after: Let them be cast away and run off like water. He will aim His arrows, and they will be cut down.
hebrew: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ־מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו [חִצָּיו] כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָלוּ׃

english_before: So that Your beloved may be delivered, save Your right hand and answer me.
english_after: So that those You love may be rescued, save them with Your right hand and answer me.
hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ ועננו [וַעֲנֵנִי׃]

english_before: My generation is uprooted and taken away from me like a shepherd's tent. Like a weaver I have cut off my life; He will cut me off from my glory. You will finish me from days and nights.
english_after: My generation was uprooted and taken from me like a shepherd’s tent. Like a weaver I cut off my life. He will strip me of my glory. By day and by night, You bring me to an end.
hebrew: דּוֹרִי נִסַּע וְנִגְלָה מִנִּי כְּאֹהֶל רֹעִי קִפַּדְתִּי כָאֹרֵג חַיַּי מִדַּלָּה יְבַצְּעֵנִי מִיּוֹם עַד־לַיְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵנִי׃

english_before: I braced myself until morning like a lion; so it would break all my bones. You will finish me from days and nights.
english_after: I braced myself until morning. Like a lion He would break all my bones. By day and by night, You bring me to an end.
hebrew: שִׁוִּיתִי עַד־בֹּקֶר כָּאֲרִי כֵּן יְשַׁבֵּר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי מִיּוֹם עַד־לַיְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵנִי׃

english_before: Woe to one contending with his Former, a potsherd among earth's potsherds! Does clay say to its potter, ‘What are you making?’ or your work say, ‘He has no place’?
english_after: Woe to anyone who contends with his Maker, a shard among shards of earth. Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Or does your work say, ‘He has no hands’?
hebrew: הוֹי רָב אֶת־יֹצְרוֹ חֶרֶשׂ אֶת־חַרְשֵׂי אֲדָמָה הֲיֹאמַר חֹמֶר לְיֹצְרוֹ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה וּפָעָלְךָ אֵין־יָדַיִם לוֹ׃

english_before: Therefore I will allot him a share in public, and he will divide spoil with the strong, because he poured out his life to death and was counted with transgressors. He bore the sin of many and intercedes for transgressors.
english_after: Therefore I will give him a share among the many, and he will divide the spoil with the strong, because he poured out his life to death and was counted with transgressors. He bore the sin of many and intercedes for transgressors.
hebrew: לָכֵן אֲחַלֶּק־לוֹ בָרַבִּים וְאֶת־עֲצוּמִים יְחַלֵּק שָׁלָל תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱרָה לַמָּוֶת נַפְשׁוֹ וְאֶת־פֹּשְׁעִים נִמְנָה וְהוּא חֵטְא־רַבִּים נָשָׂא וְלַפֹּשְׁעִים יַפְגִּיעַ׃

english_before: Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful in branches, a shady forest, tall in stature; its top was among the clouds.
english_after: Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that cast the shade of a forest. It grew tall, its crown among the thick boughs.
hebrew: הִנֵּה אַשּׁוּר אֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יְפֵה עָנָף וְחֹרֶשׁ מֵצַל וּגְבַהּ קוֹמָה וּבֵין עֲבֹתִים הָיְתָה צַמַּרְתּוֹ׃

english_before: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Because you grew tall in stature, and it set its top among the clouds and its heart rose high in its height,
english_after: Therefore, thus says Lord YHWH: Because you grew tall, and it set its crown among the thick boughs, and its heart grew proud of its height,
hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר גָּבַהְתָּ בְּקוֹמָה וַיִּתֵּן צַמַּרְתּוֹ אֶל־בֵּין עֲבוֹתִים וְרָם לְבָבוֹ בְּגָבְהוֹ׃

english_before: so that none of the water-fed trees will rise high in stature or set their tops among the clouds, and none of those drinking water will stand toward them in their height. For all of them are given to death, to the lower land, among human beings, with those descending to the pit.
english_after: so that no tree fed by water will tower high or set its crown among the thick boughs, and no tree that drinks water will stand so high. For they are all handed over to death, to the depths of the earth, among the people who go down to the pit.
hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִגְבְּהוּ בְקוֹמָתָם כָּל־עֲצֵי־מַיִם וְלֹא־יִתְּנוּ אֶת־צַמַּרְתָּם אֶל־בֵּין עֲבֹתִים וְלֹא־יַעַמְדוּ אֵלֵיהֶם בְּגָבְהָם כָּל־שֹׁתֵי מָיִם כִּי־כֻלָּם נִתְּנוּ לַמָּוֶת אֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי אָדָם אֶל־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

english_before: Those who eat his choice food will break him. His army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
english_after: Those who eat his choice food will break him. His army will sweep on, and many will fall slain.
hebrew: וְאֹכְלֵי פַת־בָּגוֹ יִשְׁבְּרוּהוּ וְחֵילוֹ יִשְׁטוֹף וְנָפְלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים׃

english_before: YHWH is a jealous and avenging God; YHWH avenges and is master of wrath. YHWH avenges His adversaries, and He reserves wrath for His enemies.
english_after: YHWH is a jealous and avenging God; YHWH avenges and is master of wrath. YHWH takes vengeance on His adversaries, and He reserves wrath for His enemies.
hebrew: אֵל קַנּוֹא וְנֹקֵם יְהוָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה וּבַעַל חֵמָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה לְצָרָיו וְנוֹטֵר הוּא לְאֹיְבָיו׃

english_before: God raised up another adversary against him: Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
english_after: God raised up an adversary against him: Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer, king of Zobah.
hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֱלֹהִים לוֹ שָׂטָן אֶת־רְזוֹן בֶּן־אֶלְיָדָע אֲשֶׁר בָּרַח מֵאֵת הֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ־צוֹבָה אֲדֹנָיו׃

english_before: YHWH had said to Ahijah, “Look, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to seek a word from you about her son, because he is ill. Thus and thus shall you speak to her.” When she came, she was disguised.
english_after: YHWH had said to Ahijah, “Look, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill. Tell her such and such. When she comes, she will be disguised.”
hebrew: וַיהוָה אָמַר אֶל־אֲחִיָּהוּ הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת יָרָבְעָם בָּאָה לִדְרֹשׁ דָּבָר מֵעִמְּךָ אֶל־בְּנָהּ כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה תְּדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ וִיהִי כְבֹאָהּ וְהִיא מִתְנַכֵּרָה׃

english_before: YHWH God said, “It is not good for the human to be alone; I will make him a helper corresponding to him.”
english_after: YHWH God said, “It is not good for the human to be alone. I will make him a helper suited to him.”
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לֹא־טוֹב הֱיוֹת הָאָדָם לְבַדּוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂהּ־לּוֹ עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ׃

english_before: The human gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the sky, and every wild animal of the field; but for the human no helper corresponding to him was found.
english_after: The human gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the sky, and every wild animal of the field, but no helper suited to him was found.
hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הָאָדָם שֵׁמוֹת לְכָל־הַבְּהֵמָה וּלְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְכֹל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּלְאָדָם לֹא־מָצָא עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ׃

english_before: “Now therefore, my son, obey my voice: arise and flee, to Laban my brother, unto Haran,”
english_after: “So now, my son, listen to me. Get up and flee to my brother Laban in Haran.”
hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְנִי שְׁמַע בְּקֹלִי וְקוּם בְּרַח־לְךָ אֶל־לָבָן אָחִי חָרָנָה׃

english_before: “Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away,”
english_after: “Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury subsides,”
hebrew: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ עִמּוֹ יָמִים אֲחָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־תָּשׁוּב חֲמַת אָחִיךָ׃

english_before: “until your brother’s anger turns away from you and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send and bring you back. Why should I be bereaved of both of you in one day?”
english_after: “until your brother’s anger turns away from you and he forgets what you did to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”
hebrew: עַד־שׁוּב אַף־אָחִיךָ מִמְּךָ וְשָׁכַח אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ וְשָׁלַחְתִּי וּלְקַחְתִּיךָ מִשָּׁם לָמָה אֶשְׁכַּל גַּם־שְׁנֵיכֶם יוֹם אֶחָד׃

english_before: “Report therefore to my father all my glory in Egypt, and all that you have seen; and make haste and bring my father down here.”
english_after: “So tell my father of all my honor in Egypt and everything you have seen. Hurry and bring my father down here.”
hebrew: וְהִגַּדְתֶּם לְאָבִי אֶת־כָּל־כְּבוֹדִי בְּמִצְרַיִם וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר רְאִיתֶם וּמִהַרְתֶּם וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת־אָבִי הֵנָּה׃

english_before: YHWH said, “I have surely seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their pains.
english_after: YHWH said, “I have indeed seen the suffering of My people in Egypt. I have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their pain.
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה רָאֹה רָאִיתִי אֶת־עֳנִי עַמִּי אֲשֶׁר בְּמִצְרָיִם וְאֶת־צַעֲקָתָם שָׁמַעְתִּי מִפְּנֵי נֹגְשָׂיו כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֶת־מַכְאֹבָיו׃

english_before: God said further to Moses, “Thus you shall say to the sons of Israel: ‘YHWH, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is My memorial from generation to generation.
english_after: God also said to Moses, “Say this to the sons of Israel: ‘YHWH, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, the name by which I am to be remembered from generation to generation.
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עוֹד אֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה כֹּה־תֹאמַר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם זֶה־שְּׁמִי לְעֹלָם וְזֶה זִכְרִי לְדֹר דֹּר׃

english_before: “Go, gather the elders of Israel, and say to them: ‘YHWH, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely attended to you and to what is being done to you in Egypt.
english_after: “Go and gather the elders of Israel. Tell them, ‘YHWH, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, appeared to me and said, “I have indeed taken notice of you and of what is being done to you in Egypt.
hebrew: לֵךְ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב לֵאמֹר פָּקֹד פָּקַדְתִּי אֶתְכֶם וְאֶת־הֶעָשׂוּי לָכֶם בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

english_before: “They will listen to your voice. You and the elders of Israel shall go to the king of Egypt and say to him, ‘YHWH, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Please let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to YHWH our God.’
english_after: “They will listen to you. Then you and the elders of Israel shall go to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘YHWH, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness to sacrifice to YHWH our God.’
hebrew: וְשָׁמְעוּ לְקֹלֶךָ וּבָאתָ אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָיו יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָעִבְרִיִּים נִקְרָה עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה נֵלֲכָה־נָּא דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וְנִזְבְּחָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

english_before: “Terror and dread fall upon them; by the greatness of Your arm they are still as stone, until Your people pass over, YHWH, until the people You acquired pass over.
english_after: “Terror and dread fall upon them. By the might of Your arm they are still as stone, until Your people pass by, YHWH, until the people You acquired pass by.
hebrew: תִּפֹּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימָתָה וָפַחַד בִּגְדֹל זְרוֹעֲךָ יִדְּמוּ כָּאָבֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹר עַמְּךָ יְהוָה עַד־יַעֲבֹר עַם־זוּ קָנִיתָ׃

english_before: He said, “If you listen diligently to the voice of YHWH your God, do what is right in His eyes, give ear to His commandments, and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you that I put on the Egyptians, for I am YHWH who heals you.”
english_after: He said, “If you listen carefully to the voice of YHWH your God, do what is right in His eyes, heed His commandments, and keep all His statutes, I will not bring upon you any of the diseases I brought upon Egypt. For I am YHWH, who heals you.”
hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע לְקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְהַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו תַּעֲשֶׂה וְהַאֲזַנְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָיו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ כָּל־חֻקָּיו כָּל־הַמַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־אָשִׂים עָלֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה רֹפְאֶךָ׃

english_before: Seraphim stood above Him, six wings for each, six wings for each: with two each covered his face, with two his feet, and with two he flew.
english_after: Seraphim stood above Him, each with six wings. With two each covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.
hebrew: שְׂרָפִים עֹמְדִים מִמַּעַל לוֹ שֵׁשׁ כְּנָפַיִם שֵׁשׁ כְּנָפַיִם לְאֶחָד בִּשְׁתַּיִם יְכַסֶּה פָנָיו וּבִשְׁתַּיִם יְכַסֶּה רַגְלָיו וּבִשְׁתַּיִם יְעוֹפֵף׃

english_before: The threshold supports shook at the caller's voice, and the house filled with smoke.
english_after: The supports of the thresholds shook at the voice of the one who called, and the house filled with smoke.
hebrew: וַיָּנֻעוּ אַמּוֹת הַסִּפִּים מִקּוֹל הַקּוֹרֵא וְהַבַּיִת יִמָּלֵא עָשָׁן׃

english_before: I said, “Until when, Lord?” He said, “Until cities are devastated without a resident, houses without a person, and the soil is devastated into desolation;

hebrew: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה כִּי לֹא־תָמְנוּ כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמָיו׃
english_after: By YHWH’s acts of steadfast love we have not perished, for His compassions have not come to an end.

hebrew: חֲדָשִׁים לַבְּקָרִים רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
english_after: They are new every morning. Great is Your faithfulness.

hebrew: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עַל־כֵּן אוֹחִיל לוֹ׃
english_after: “YHWH is my portion,” says my soul. “So I will hope in Him.”

hebrew: יִתֵּן בֶּעָפָר פִּיהוּ אוּלַי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה׃
english_after: Let him put his mouth in the dust. There may yet be hope.

hebrew: וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאָזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃
english_after: He shall flee to one of these cities, stand at the entrance to the city gate, and state his case to its elders. They shall take him into the city, give him a place, and let him live among them.

hebrew: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃
english_after: If the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not hand the killer over to him, for he struck his neighbor unknowingly and had not hated him before.

hebrew: וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃
english_after: He shall stay in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the killer may return to his city and his home, to the city from which he fled.

hebrew: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים בְּקֶרֶב חֲכָמִים תָּלִין׃
english_after: An ear that listens to life-giving correction will dwell among the wise.

hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן אָשִׁיב אֶת־שְׁבוּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃
english_after: But afterward I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites, declares YHWH.
